[i][sub]Condemnation of Nationstates GamePlay[/sub][/i]

Since the time of Noah, there have been attempts to slaughter the greater half, to tear the honoured asunder. Most notably, the slaughtering of Abel by Cain, for Abel offered to the Divine a flock of greatness, and Cain offered merely wheat. Today, another attempt at jealous murder has been undertaken by the vile forces of NationStates Gameplay. Like Cain, they fear us, they fear our lack of fealty to their Empire of Evil. Today, they have raised a knife to bring down on the back of our humble Region, but unlike Abel, we fought back! 

Grand Marshal Zharvekia struck down the dogs who attempted to bite at our heels. Like Sir Winston Churchill, we stand alone, and we stand victorious! Our great ideology, Dabirstani-Westmorian-Zharvekian Juche, has steeled our resolve, let us give praise to the Council! We will tighten our belts as our Region returns to a state of isolationism against the wider world. We will forever ensure our independence and freedom from the United States of NationStates Gameplay, the Empire of Evil which has brought down many fledgling states, and sought to bring down Cordone! Our Democratic Peoples Councillor Republic stands free and untainted by their Imperialist aggression!

For over five hundred days, Cordone has stood proudly as a shelter from the storm of tyranny, under the wise and eternal guidance of our Council, to whom we must once more give praise for their ceaseless efforts. They who move mountains for Cordone! For our RolePlay! For the People! These aggressors sought to bring an end to the Endless Council! For that, they were fools, our Council, blessed by the Almighty and given Sovereignty by the Will of the People, will never falter in their duty and will never fall to the acts of the Empire of Evil! Even now, as they starve our shelter of new welcomers, we stand firm and unyielding! We will tighten our belts, and we will endure whatever onslaught of insults they will levy, slander is the coward's way, and truly verify the cowardice of these people!

The Democratic Peoples Republic of Cordone issues a formal condemnation of these attempted acts!

Praise be to Grand Marshal Zharvekia!
Praise be to Eternal President Dabiristan!
Praise be to Respected Comrade New Westmore!

And due honours to the People's Representative, First Deputy Trucklos!

Long live the Council!

Long live the Democratic Peoples Republic of Cordone!
